24.original: Keep lookout at the designated locations and slay any beasts that appear.

48.original: Y-You travel with Wuk Lamat, don't you? That means you must be strong, and strong's what I need right about now!

49.original: These ruins tend to attract wild beasts, so we send out regular patrols to check them from time to time. But as soon as I got here, I was overwhelmed!

50.original: I managed to fight them off and escape, but my weapons broke in the struggle. I can't hope to finish my patrol now, unless I want to end up as some fiend's lunch...

51.original: I hate to shirk my duty like this, but I have no choice but to ask you to patrol the area in my stead. Those things might still be lurking about─if you find them, I reckon you know what to do.

52.original: I'm helpless without my weapons. Please, patrol the area in my stead─and be vigilant for any remaining fiends.

53.original: You sense no hostile presences nearby.

54.original: You're back. I heard the sounds of battle, but all seems quiet now... Thank you.

55.original: You wouldn't think it to see the ruins now, but this place used to be a vibrant village of gatherers. They took their bounty from the verdant nature around them.

56.original: But they weren't a fighting people, and as our conflict with the Mamool Ja escalated, one by one they chose to find safety elsewhere...until their home was abandoned completely.

57.original: Ilyon Asoh means “scars that remain.” And this place is a scar we all bear. We keep the old buildings here as a reminder of the toll war exacts on us all, so that we don't repeat the mistakes of the past.

58.original: Well, I'd better report to the hunters that all is well. Here, please accept this token of my gratitude!
